risks.note: The Company holds user and business data at scale; it names controlled access, strict safeguards, an ISMS framework and security systems as the controls that reduce the risk of breaches.

Flagged as a principal risk in the MD&A risk table; the stated defence is a long-standing local database, ongoing product enhancement and a diversified category mix creating scale and depth the Company describes as difficult to replicate.
Mitigated by continuous tracking of user behaviour and product development across JD Mart, JD Omni and JD Pay.

sk.overview: India's organised retail comprises organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce, with e-commerce the fastest-growing format. India retail was ~Rs 83 trillion in FY2025 (~21% organised) and is projected to reach Rs 123-135 trillion by FY2030. India e-commerce (including quick commerce) is ~Rs 6 trillion GMV (~US$70 billion) currently, projected to reach Rs 15-18 trillion (12-13% retail penetration) by FY2030.
